### A Word to Fathers - Truth For Life - July 9, 2026
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-9-2026.html
Passage: Ephesians 6:4
Points:
- Unlike the harsh, unchecked paternal authority common in ancient Roman culture, Scripture calls fathers to exercise their authority with restraint.
- Parents easily exasperate their children through severity, inconsistency, favoritism, unreasonable demands, or constant fault-finding.
- Paul calls fathers positively to nourish their children over many years using biblical discipline and gentle instruction.
- Faithful Christian parenting is a long-term investment that requires ongoing patience and dependence on God's sufficient grace.

### Why It Matters That We Honor Our Parents - The Crosswalk Devotional - August 15
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/honoring-our-parents-well-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Ephesians 6:1-3
Points:
- Paul instructs children under parental care to practice obedience rooted in a heart desire to submit to the Lord.
- Obeying parents is not merely an optional suggestion but an essential moral expectation commanded by God.
- Honoring parents grounds itself in the fifth commandment, which is paired with a divine promise of well-being.
- Learning submission within the home establishes the foundation for respecting God's authority and spares children unnecessary life conflict.
